isolation.evidence: Fresh 'claude -p --model claude-haiku-5-5' process (session 20334389-a8b8-4311-be56-080d14aa55ac) started in an empty opaque working directory outside the repository, with only the frozen prompt.md piped on stdin. No coordinator conversation, sibling outputs, or evaluation criteria were passed. Tools: Read, Write, Edit. User-global Claude Code configuration still loaded.

limitations: Worker ran with the user's global Claude Code configuration (user-level settings, global instructions, and user MCP servers may have been visible). No project AGENTS.md or repository files were in its working directory.
The frozen prompt.md was piped verbatim as the user message. The execution envelope added one appended system-prompt line: 'Write your deliverable to output/index.html in the current directory.'
Tools were limited to Read, Write, and Edit (--allowedTools, --permission-mode acceptEdits). Bash and PowerShell were denied, so the worker could not execute or browser-test its output.
Permission denials reported by the CLI: 7.
No --effort flag was passed; the reasoning setting is the CLI default and is not reported in the usage output.
The three cells of this run executed concurrently as separate processes on the same host; each had its own opaque working directory under the coordinator scratchpad, outside the repository.
startedAt/completedAt are the wrapper script's process clock around the claude invocation; durationMs is the CLI-reported duration_ms.
tokenUsage is copied from the CLI --output-format json usage report; total_tokens is the sum of input, cache read, cache creation and output tokens.
